chunks: Abu Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) said to me, “O Jabir, indeed Allah, the first thing He created, created Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) and his progeny, the guiding ones, the guided ones. So they were phantoms of light before Allah.” I said, “What are the phantoms?” He said, “The shadow of light: luminous bodies without spirits, and he was supported by one spirit, and that is the Spirit of Holiness.”

So by it he worshipped Allah, and his progeny, and for that reason He created them forbearing, learned, righteous, pure ones. They worship Allah through salat (prayer), sawm (fasting), sajdah (prostration), tasbih (glorification), and tahlil, and they perform the prayers, perform hajj, and fast.

key_terms.الْهُدَاةَ: the guides who lead creation to truth
key_terms.رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ: the Holy Spirit by which divine support is given
key_terms.عِتْرَتَهُ: his progeny, referring to the family of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله)
key_terms.نُورٍ: light, indicating a luminous primordial mode of creation

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the pre-eternal creation of Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) and his Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the primordial creation of Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) and his purified progeny as beings of light, supported by the Holy Spirit before earthly embodiment. It emphasizes their exalted ontological rank and their constant devotion to Allah through acts of worship.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Mufazzal, from Jabir Bin Yazeed who said, 
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Jabir! Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the first of what He<sup>azwj</sup> Created was the creation of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> family, the guides, the Guided. So they<sup>asws</sup> were resemblances of ‘نُورٍ’ Light in front of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’. I said, ‘And what are the resemblances?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘ظِلُّ النُّورِ’ ‘Shadows of light, bodies of light without spirits, and they<sup>asws</sup> were Supported by one spirit, and it is the Holy Spirit.

So by it, hesaww and hissaww familyasws worshipped Allahazwj, and it was for that that Heazwj Created themasws as forbearing scholars, righteous, elites worshipping Allahazwj with the Salat, and the Sawm (Fasts), and the Sujood (Prostrations), and the Tasbeeh (Glorifications), and the extollation of Oneness, and theyasws are praying Salat, and theyasws are performing Hajj, and theyasws are Fasting’.
en.sarwar: 10. Al-Husayn has narrated from (Muhammad) ibn ‘Abdallah from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Mufaddal from Jabir ibn Yazid who has said the following. “Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) said to me, ‘O Jabir, the first thing that Allah created was Muhammad (s.a) and his offspring who are the rightly guided guides. They existed in ’Ashabah (form ) of light in the presence of Allah.” I then asked, “What is ’Ashabah?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is the shadow of light, the lighting bodies without the spirit. It was supported by one spirit which is the Holy spirit.

In that state he and his offspring worshipped Allah and for this reason He created them forbearing scholars, conscientious pure one who worship Allah through prayer, fasting, prostration, speaking of His Glory and the acknowledgment that He is the only Lord. They perform prayers, perform Hajj and fast.”
